comment: The text says some children may be “denied services” without registry capability. Lack of formal registration should never be treated as justification for denial of essential health services.

anchor.note: p.116 l.Lines 73-78 read as the printed page; section 2 agrees

public.text: The text says some children may be “denied services” without registry capability. Lack of formal registration should never be treated as justification for denial of essential health services.
public.suggestedRevision: State explicitly that the Client Registry must support care without foundational documentation and that registration or matching uncertainty must not become a barrier to essential service access.
